title: Wind Chimes of Chaos
description: Two curved rows of metallic wind chimes with bells hang diagonally across a dark abstract space. Below them, a black raven and a red-brown bird of prey with open beaks appear to scream upward as bright white starburst explosions and light streaks radiate from the center.
prompt: Dark surreal painting featuring two curved rows of hanging metallic wind chimes and bells suspended diagonally across a chaotic black and deep red background. Bright white starburst light explosions and motion streaks emanate from the center. Below, a black raven and a reddish-brown bird of prey with open beaks appear to shriek upward. Dramatic, painterly brushstrokes, high contrast, moody atmosphere.
